test_objective: Check that the default @context is used if the Content-Type header is "application/json" and the Link header does not contain a JSON-LD @context

test_cases.name: 003_05_01 Create a batch of one entity using the default context with JSON content type
test_cases.doc: Check that the default @context is used if the Content-Type header is "application/json" and the Link header does not contain a JSON-LD @context and retrieve the entity without context
test_cases.then:
then {
    the SUT sends a valid Response for the operations:
        Batch Create Entities with Response Status Code set to 201     and
        Retrieve Entity by Id with Check Response Body containing an Attribute set to and
            Query Parameter: expected_attribute_name set to 'almostFull' and
            Query Parameter: response_body set to 'response1.json()'
}
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entityOperations/create'
        method set to 'POST'
        Request Header['Content-Type'] set to 'application/json' and
 payload set to a list of entities to be created
}
